tasks.title: Build the lifecycle projection relational store
tasks.summary: Create additive Postgres schema, indexes, typed persistence API, and atomic event-to-checkpoint transaction primitives without changing telemetry source authority.
tasks.owner_capability: backend-data auto-worker with PostgreSQL migration and transaction expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent database correctness, security, and operability review
acceptance: Add expand-only idempotent migrations for controller, event receipts, identity links, journeys, journey stages, loop runs, and quarantine with all plan-required keys and indexes.
Use a least-privilege runtime contract and never copy unrestricted raw telemetry payloads into projection tables.
Provide one transaction API that atomically records disposition, identity/stage/aggregate changes, projection revision, and contiguous checkpoint.
Prove duplicate, conflicting duplicate, identity conflict, quarantine, rollback, retry, and two-writer/advisory-lock behavior against real Postgres.
Publish reviewed PR, required checks, merge SHA, migration up/idempotency evidence, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: focused projection store tests against real Postgres
migration apply twice and backward-compatible prior-reader probe
EXPLAIN evidence for source checkpoint, identity resolution, journey list, timeline, and loop list indexes
tasks.rollout: Apply the additive schema in target-dev with no worker or BFF reader enabled.
tasks.rollback: Stop consumers and leave additive tables unused; destructive down migration is prohibited.

tasks.title: Replace full rebuild with a bounded incremental reducer
tasks.summary: Extract deterministic per-event reduction and rewire the lifecycle worker so one batch mutates only affected relational aggregates and controller state.
tasks.owner_capability: backend auto-worker with event-sourcing, idempotency, and Python performance expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent lifecycle semantics, recovery, and memory review
acceptance: Remove all-history canonical_events and identity_chains from runtime state and remove full-state deepcopy/full-global render from the active worker path.
Keep memory bounded to the configured batch, per-batch maps, and affected aggregate rows.
Preserve canonical lifecycle event, fixture, identity, stage ordering, duplicate, conflict, quarantine, live/recovery/backfill/replay, and freshness semantics.
Commit each source batch through the store transaction and advance only the highest contiguous durably disposed sequence.
Prove deterministic convergence for duplicate, out-of-order, restart, replay, backfill, SIGKILL, and injected transaction failure.
Publish reviewed PR, required checks, merge SHA, focused/adjacent tests, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: property and differential tests over accepted legacy fixtures
canonical paper lifecycle integration tests
SIGTERM/SIGKILL and database reconnect fault tests
static assertion that active code has no full-history in-memory store or global rebuild
tasks.rollout: Deploy disabled, then run only as a target-dev shadow writer after migration task admission.
tasks.rollback: Stop the new worker; source rows and relational schema remain intact.

tasks.title: Serve Trade Journey and loop-run reads from Postgres
tasks.summary: Implement tenant-scoped indexed repositories and keyset pagination behind the current BFF DTO and route contracts.
tasks.owner_capability: BFF/backend auto-worker with PostgreSQL query, pagination, RBAC, and API compatibility expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent API contract, tenant isolation, privacy, and performance review
acceptance: Add scoped Postgres repository methods for journey page/detail/timeline/graph/resolve/evidence/metrics, loop page/detail, and controller freshness.
Preserve existing route paths and response contracts while adding bounded keyset pagination with default 50 and maximum 200.
Reject tampered or filter/scope-incompatible page tokens and prohibit unscoped global list APIs.
Preserve identifier-existence protection, RBAC, tenant/environment isolation, and live-sensitive-field redaction.
Expose stale/error/backlog truth without representing fallback JSON as current Postgres truth.
Publish reviewed PR, required checks, merge SHA, compatibility/security/query-plan evidence, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: existing Trade Journey and loop-run contract suites
pagination stability and token tamper tests
cross-tenant/environment and sensitive-field negative tests
indexed query and bounded returned-row evidence
tasks.rollout: Ship behind one disabled projection-reader backend flag in target-dev.
tasks.rollback: Leave the BFF on its previously accepted reader backend.

tasks.title: Backfill, shadow, and prove lifecycle projection parity
tasks.summary: Build resumable source backfill and deterministic old/new parity tooling, then close the delta in shadow-live mode without serving the new store.
tasks.owner_capability: backend/data migration auto-worker with replay, reconciliation, and evidence expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent migration safety, parity, and recovery review
acceptance: Backfill from telemetry_events with a separate durable migration watermark and resumable bounded transactions.
Capture a source high watermark, close the delta with the incremental worker, and enter shadow-live with backlog zero.
Compare controller, identity, stage, journey, loop, quarantine, duplicate, replay, and recovery semantics using stable scoped hashes and drill-down reports.
Classify every mismatch as an approved documented contract change or blocker; unexplained mismatch count is zero.
Prove safe interruption/restart at multiple backfill and delta positions without duplicates or skipped source rows.
Publish reviewed PR, required checks, merge SHA, redacted parity manifest, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: full dev-source backfill in bounded batches
restart and source-growth-during-backfill tests
stable hash plus sampled row-level parity
no raw payload or sensitive identifier leakage in evidence
tasks.rollout: Run only in target-dev shadow mode with BFF reads unchanged.
tasks.rollback: Stop shadow/backfill jobs; retain the new schema for inspection and leave the accepted reader unchanged.

tasks.title: Prove bounded lifecycle projection capacity and failure behavior
tasks.summary: Exercise one million events, query plans, resource ceilings, and transactional fault recovery before any reader cutover.
tasks.owner_capability: performance/reliability auto-worker with Python, PostgreSQL, Docker, and fault-injection expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent capacity, SLO, and rollback evidence review
acceptance: Pass at least 1,000,000 canonical events and 150,000 loop runs with steady RSS <=2.0 GiB, peak RSS <=2.5 GiB, and 500k-to-1M RSS growth <=256 MiB.
Pass 500-row batch p95 <=5 seconds, steady backlog age p95 <=30 seconds, and baseline-plus-100k catch-up <=30 minutes on the documented dev profile.
Pass journey/loop list and detail p95 gates with page <=200 and indexed query plans without unbounded scans.
Pass SIGKILL, DB disconnect, deadlock, transaction rollback, second-writer, duplicate, and out-of-order fault cases with RPO=0 and no duplicate stages.
Set the target worker memory limit to 4 GiB only after the measured gates pass; keep fail-stopped semantics on deterministic defects.
Publish reproducible corpus seed/config, raw redacted metrics, reviewed PR, merge SHA, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: one-million-event benchmark on documented hardware
RSS/time/backlog sample series and query EXPLAIN plans
fault matrix with authoritative post-restart controller and row counts
docker compose config and focused/adjacent test suites
tasks.rollout: Apply resource defaults only to the disabled/shadow target worker in target-dev.
tasks.rollback: Revert the compose/config commit and stop the shadow worker; do not restart the legacy unbounded worker.

tasks.title: Canary and cut over target-dev lifecycle reads
tasks.summary: Deploy exact merged identities, canary the Postgres reader, prove a real paper lifecycle and rollback, then switch target-dev reads.
tasks.owner_capability: dev release/reliability auto-worker with hosted probes, migration, and rollback expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent release, security, readback, and rollback approval
acceptance: Deploy exact merged Pantheon SHA and image digest with migration identity, configuration, and controller row recorded before enabling reads.
Keep shadow backlog zero and unexplained parity mismatch zero, then enable Postgres reads for an authorized target-dev paper canary before all target-dev paper reads.
Prove one real paper signal-to-reconciliation lifecycle with identity-consistent journey and loop run through authenticated canonical BFF readback.
Prove stale, conflict, cross-tenant/environment, sensitive-field, and unauthorized negative behavior.
Rehearse rollback to the last accepted reader and forward recovery without data loss; the stale legacy bundle must remain labeled stale.
Observe 24 hours with accepted freshness/resource/error gates and publish reviewed PR, merge SHA, deployment manifest, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: pre-switch parity/capacity/security gate
authenticated hosted list/detail/timeline/graph/loop/controller readback
real target-dev paper lifecycle correlation
rollback and forward-recovery rehearsal
tasks.rollout: Shadow -> authorized target-dev paper canary -> all target-dev paper reads -> 24-hour observation.
tasks.rollback: Switch the single BFF reader flag to the last accepted backend, restart only BFF, stop the new worker if necessary, and report stale truth.

tasks.title: Retire legacy lifecycle JSON projection after accepted soak
tasks.summary: After seven accepted dev days and explicit approval, remove legacy writer/read paths and prune obsolete dev generations through a dry-run, checksummed process.
tasks.owner_capability: backend/operations auto-worker with compatibility cleanup and safe data-retirement expertise
tasks.reviewer_capability: independent retention, recovery, and destructive-action approval
out_of_scope: cleanup before seven accepted dev days and explicit operator approval
acceptance: Show at least seven days of accepted target-dev freshness, capacity, parity, security, and error evidence after cutover.
Remove legacy JSON writer and read fallback code/config through a reviewed PR while preserving public BFF contracts.
Generate an allow-listed dry-run inventory and checksum manifest for obsolete dev generations; no broad path, glob, unresolved variable, or canonical source is eligible.
Require explicit Human/Ops approval after dry-run before moving/deleting legacy dev files, and record whether recovery remains possible.
Run hosted regression and restart/recovery proof on the Postgres-only path, then update the runbook and residual-risk register.
Publish reviewed PR, required checks, merge SHA, deletion receipt if approved, and checksummed evidence.json.
validation: seven-day soak manifest
legacy-reference static search and compatibility suites
dry-run exact-path inventory and checksums
Postgres-only hosted restart/readback and rollback documentation
tasks.rollout: Remove legacy code/config first; execute dev file cleanup separately only after explicit post-dry-run approval.
tasks.rollback: Revert application code to the schema-compatible prior reader. Recover moved legacy files from the recorded quarantine/archive location if cleanup occurred.

program_acceptance: All dependencies are done rather than superseded, cancelled, missing, or merely submitted.
Every task has a merged reviewed PR, exact merge SHA, required checks, and checksummed evidence manifest.
Target-dev serves Postgres projection reads with accepted freshness after a real paper lifecycle and a successful rollback rehearsal.
The target worker meets the one-million-event resource gates and has no all-history runtime object graph or global rebuild path.
No production, live-capital, canonical source deletion, or supervisor-control-plane change occurred.
